item.title: All three parish girls high school basketball teams reach state playoffs
item.description: As usual, Natchitoches Central’s girls are starting the LHSAA basketball playoffs at home Thursday but it’s travel time for the girls teams from St. Mary’s and Lakeview. item.title: Thurgood Marshall documentary gives NSU students legal perspective on civil rights
item.description: A documentary screening of the life of Thurgood Marshall led to discussion about how the U.S Constitution is interpreted, impactful statutes that the public should be aware of and the role that courage plays in practicing law. Northwestern State University’s Gail Metoyer Jones Center, NSU’s NAACP Chapter and Black Studies, Pre-Law & Paralegal Studies programs hosted … Continue reading Thurgood Marshall documentary gives NSU students legal perspective on civil rights

item.title: Natchitoches Lions Club Members Complete Regional Leadership Institute
item.description: The Natchitoches Lions Club announced that members Michael and Sarah Giannone completed the Regional Lions Leadership Institute held in Lafayette. During the institute, participants focused on leadership development, team building and member engagement, all aimed at strengthening local clubs and expanding community impact. item.title: SAVE THE DATE: The 11th Annual Pub Crawl
item.description: FAUNA (Friends All United for Natchitoches Animals) is excited to announce that it will once again host the annual Natchitoches Pub Crawl.
